violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - All Directions (26 TAC §746.4809(a))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - All Directions
violation_type.typical_finding: One tire swing structure that did not have the required use zone. The operation will not use this structure until the required use zone can be obtained.

finding_variants.text: One tire swing structure that did not have the required use zone. The operation will not use this structure until the required use zone can be obtained.
The use zone of the tire swing on the three's playground did not extend 9 feet 6 inches in all directions.
